name: slider
title: Slider
description: Range slider built on a native input type range, with a primary fill, a round thumb, and the current value shown next to the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text above the slider, linked through for/id. Without it, pass aria-label.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment used by dragging and the arrow keys.

props.name: value / defaultValue / v-model
props.description: Current value. Blade uses value, React value or defaultValue, Vue v-model or defaultValue.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: React only. Called with the new number on every input.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current value on the right of the label with tabular numbers.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the slider and dims the label.

a11y: A native input type range, so screen readers announce the role slider and the current value.
Arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, and End change the value natively.
The visible value is aria-hidden because the slider already announces it.

ai.whenToUse: Picking an approximate number in a known range where the exact value matters less than the position, such as volume, brightness, or a price limit.
rules: Use Input type number when users need to type an exact value
Always give a label, or aria-label when the label is not visible
Keep the step coarse enough to reach every value with the keyboard

id.description: Slider rentang dari input type range native, dengan isian primary, thumb bulat, dan nilai saat ini di samping label.

props.label: Teks label di atas slider, terhubung lewat for/id. Tanpa label, isi aria-label.
props.step: Kenaikan nilai saat digeser dan saat memakai tombol panah.
props.value / defaultValue / v-model: Nilai saat ini. Blade memakai value, React value atau defaultValue, Vue v-model atau defaultValue.
props.onValueChange: Khusus React. Dipanggil dengan angka baru setiap kali digeser.
props.showValue: Menampilkan nilai saat ini di kanan label dengan angka tabular.
props.id: Id input. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.

a11y: Input type range native, sehingga screen reader membacakan peran slider dan nilainya.
Tombol panah, Page Up, Page Down, Home, dan End mengubah nilai secara native.
Nilai yang tampil diberi aria-hidden karena slider sudah membacakannya.

ai.whenToUse: Memilih angka perkiraan dalam rentang yang diketahui, saat posisi lebih penting dari nilai persis, misalnya volume, kecerahan, atau batas harga.
rules: Pakai Input type number kalau pengguna perlu mengetik nilai persis
Selalu beri label, atau aria-label kalau label tidak terlihat
Pilih step yang cukup kasar agar semua nilai bisa dicapai dengan keyboard
